metadata.purpose: Legacy-preserving claim-level evidence review; not a newly certified benchmark
metadata.admission_policy: Only independently verified host/phase/site/concentration claims may earn quantitative credit.

resulting_compositions: (Al_x Ga_{1-x})2 O3 (monoclinic beta-phase up to x ≈ 0.70)
(In_x Ga_{1-x})2 O3 (monoclinic beta-phase up to x ≈ 0.35)
legacy_record.experimental_status: Synthesized as single crystals, bulk ceramics, and epitaxial thin films (MBE, MOCVD, PLD) preserving C2/m space group.
legacy_record.computational_status: Supported by DFT formation energy convex hulls and phonon stability calculations (Peelaers et al., 2017).
legacy_record.source_reference: Peelaers et al., Appl. Phys. Lett. 112, 242101 (2018); Baldini et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 30, 194001 (2018)
legacy_record.verification_notes: Both Al and In substitute directly on the Ga_II octahedral 4i site forming verified solid solutions. Heterovalent/dilute donors (Si, Sn) are strictly excluded from primary targets and moved to secondary cases.

In_x Ga_{1-x} N (solid solution up to x ≈ 0.40 in commercial LEDs)
legacy_record.experimental_status: Extensively commercialized optoelectronic alloys grown via MOVPE and MBE; complete tetrahedral cation sublattice substitution.
legacy_record.computational_status: Well-documented electronic band gap bowing and formation enthalpies across the ternary phase diagram.
legacy_record.source_reference: Ambacher, J. Phys. D: Appl. Phys. 31, 2653 (1998); Nakamura et al., Nobel Lecture (2015)
legacy_record.verification_notes: Hexagonal wurtzite has exactly one Wyckoff site (2b) for the cation; substitution is geometrically unique and experimentally proven. Mg acceptor doping is moved to secondary cases.

resulting_compositions: CsPb_{1-x} Sn_x I3 (continuous lead-free halide perovskite solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
legacy_record.experimental_status: Synthesized as single crystals, thin films, and colloidal quantum dots for photovoltaic solar cells.
legacy_record.computational_status: Bandgap bowing and thermodynamic miscibility confirmed by DFT (Stoumpos et al., 2013).
legacy_record.source_reference: Stoumpos et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 135, 9093-9109 (2013)
legacy_record.verification_notes: Ge is rejected from primary ground truth due to negligible solubility (<5%) and severe octahedral distortion. Sn forms an experimentally validated isostructural solid solution. Bi is rejected due to double perovskite phase separation.
